comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Released briefly on Maris server. If you equip it (without layered head slot item) or layer it, butterflies will follow you around wherever you go. Don't worry if they fall behind, they know how to teleport and catch up. Stats:

Archaeology +3
Theology +2
Female-only

Source/pics: gamecity.ne.jp/dol/topics_cms/campaign/8415.html
